source.prompt: An American robin (Turdus migratorius), one adult male standing on the ground, side-on pose, upright alert thrush posture, wings folded tight against the body. Realistic proportions: 25 cm long, a round chest, a medium-long tail, a straight yellow bill, long thin legs. Dark grey-brown back, wings and tail, a blackish head with a broken white eye ring, a white-streaked throat, a brick-red orange breast and belly, white under the tail. Three toes forward and one back. No base, no perch. Game-ready, clean closed mesh.

tiers.note: Scaled to 0.25 m bill to tail. The preview (a faceted but good thrush) kept: the head, round chest and straight bill; pitched 6 degrees nose-down from its alert pose to a ground forager's near-level stance (the body about 25 degrees nose-up); the generated legs and long tail cut and replaced by long dark procedural legs and a square 10 cm tail 16 degrees below level; black eyes with a pale ring behind each; round flight cards with a rufous underwing. Colours (COLOR_0, the male): blackish head, white throat streaked black, dark grey-brown back, wings and tail with pale feather edges on lod0, brick-red orange breast and flanks, white lower belly, vent and undertail, yellow bill with a dark tip. _COLORB is the female: greyer head and back, paler orange breast. Triangles: lod0 998 = 829 body + 169 legs, tail, cards, eyes; lod1 400 = 311 body + 89 legs, tail, cards, eyes; lod2 120 = 93 body + 27 legs, tail, cards, eyes. GLB 213,188 bytes. lod_m is a suggestion.

rig: bird rig template of the Steller's jay (tools/build_stellersjay.py; drawn with client/src/animalModels.js RIG.stjay's constants): PART BODY 0, LEG_A 1 / LEG_B 2 procedural legs (pivot at the knee), TAIL 3 procedural tail (pivot at the rump), HEAD 6 (head and neck, pivot at the base of the neck), WING_L/R 4/5 and HAND_L/R 9/10 flight cards that collapse into the shoulder on pose; extras.rig {kind 'bird', wing (shoulder), tail (rump), head (neck base), length_m}; no skin; extras.rig.variant 'female in _COLORB': aAnim2.w selects the female colour set (_COLORB), as the turkey's hen
accuracy_notes: Built 2026-11-06. Reads at once as a robin: dark head, orange breast, yellow bill, white vent, the long dark tail. Still open: the eye ring is one pale octahedron behind each eye, so it reads as a full ring (the real one is broken above and below); the throat streaks are per-face colour, coarse at lod0; the tail is a flat plate, thin side-on; the orange-grey boundary on the flank is saw-toothed (per-face colour).
